title: Holding several prescriptions on the Prescriptions & Renewals line
content:
**Condition.** A patient may hold any number of Prescriptions & Renewals prescriptions for different medications. No maximum number of prescriptions per patient is set.

**Scope of the condition.** The absence of a maximum concerns prescriptions for *different* medications. How many prescriptions of one medication and strength may be open at the same time is not decided by this condition; it is a separate limit of the Prescriptions & Renewals line, the same-medication limit.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A patient who holds an active Standard Maintenance Prescription for a blood-pressure medication, an active Monitored Maintenance Prescription for a thyroid medication and an expired Acute Short-Course Prescription for an antibiotic is not limited, under this condition, in adding a prescription for a further, different medication.
